```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(rstudioapi)
library(Hmisc)
```

```{r}
# Put experiment ID here:
expid <- "14"
# Load data
mkdir <- dirname(getActiveDocumentContext()$path)
mkdir <- gsub("rcode", "", mkdir)
mkdir <- paste0(mkdir, "data")
setwd(mkdir)
ref <- which(grepl(paste(expid, "_", sep = ""), dir(), fixed = TRUE))
data <- read_csv(dir()[ref])
reversals <- 4
```

```{r}
# Select final 4 reversals in each staircase for each Participant
last_revs <- data.frame()
for (i in unique(data$Participant)) {
  for (j in unique(data$start_id)) {
    for (k in unique(data$type)) {
      for (l in unique(data$envelope_1)) {
        for (m in unique(data$repetition)) {
          for (n in unique(data$direction)) {
            rev = subset(data, Participant == i & type == k & envelope_1 == l & repetition == m & direction == n & l_reversal == 1)
            if (!j %in% rev$start_id) next
            rev = subset(rev, start_id == j)
            num = length(rev$l_reversal) - reversals
            rev = rev[-c(1:num),]
            last_revs <- rbind(last_revs, rev)
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

```{r}
# Categorise each reversal
k = 1
for (i in 1:nrow(last_revs)) {
  if (k > reversals) k = 1
  last_revs$trial_num[i] <- k
  k = k + 1
}
```

```{r}
# Group and condense response/reversal data
revs <- last_revs |> 
  group_by(Participant, start_id, direction, envelope_1, type, repetition, trial_num) |> 
  summarise("Level" = mean(second - first)) |> 
  mutate("trial_num" = as.integer(trial_num), "start_id" = factor(start_id)) |> 
  arrange(Participant, start_id, direction, envelope_1, type, repetition, trial_num)
```

```{r}
# Calculate PSE for each standard and envelope for each participant (and Z scores)
pse <- revs |> 
  group_by(Participant, start_id, envelope_1, type, repetition) |> 
  summarise("PSE" = mean(Level))
pse$PSEZ <- ((pse$PSE - mean(pse$PSE)) / sd(pse$PSE))

pse$PSEtotal <- 0
pse$standard <- 0
for (i in 1:length(unique(pse$envelope_1))) {
  for (j in 1:length(unique(pse$start_id))) {
    e <- unique(pse$envelope_1)[i]
    if (!j %in% unique(pse$start_id[pse$envelope_1 == e])) next
    pse$PSEtotal[pse$envelope_1 == unique(pse$envelope_1)[i] & pse$start_id == j] <- data$first[data$envelope_1 == unique(pse$envelope_1)[i] & data$start_id == j] + pse$PSE[pse$envelope_1 == unique(pse$envelope_1)[i] & pse$start_id == j]
    pse$standard[pse$envelope_1 == unique(pse$envelope_1)[i] & pse$start_id == j] <- data$first[data$envelope_1 == unique(pse$envelope_1)[i] & data$start_id == j]
  }
}
pse_new <- pse[rep(seq_len(nrow(pse)), each = 2), ]
for (i in 1:length(pse_new$Participant)) {
  if ((i %% 2) == 0) {
    pse_new$PSEtotal[i] <- pse_new$PSEtotal[i] - pse_new$PSE[i]
  }
}
pse$ratio <- pse$PSEtotal / pse$standard
pse$recip <- ifelse(pse$envelope_1 == "perc", (1 / pse$ratio), pse$ratio)
pse$recip[pse$type == "Homogeneous"] <- pse$ratio[pse$type == "Homogeneous"]
```

```{r}
discrep <- revs |> 
  group_by(Participant, start_id, envelope_1, type, repetition, direction) |> 
  summarise("PSE" = mean(Level)) |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = direction, values_from = PSE) |> 
  mutate("discrepency" = Above - Below) 
```

```{r}
ycoords <- revs |> 
  group_by(Participant, start_id, envelope_1, type, repetition, direction) |> 
  summarise("PSE" = mean(Level)) |> 
  mutate("coord" = "Y")
xcoords <- ycoords
xcoords$coord <- "X"
coords <- rbind(ycoords, xcoords) |> 
  arrange(envelope_1) |> 
  arrange(start_id) |> 
  arrange(Participant) |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = coord, values_from = PSE)
coords <- coords[rep(seq_len(nrow(coords)), each = 2), ]
coords$X <- rep_len(c(0,95,95,0), length.out = nrow(coords))
for (i in 1:length(unique(pse$envelope_1))) {
  for (j in 1:length(unique(pse$start_id))) {
    e <- unique(pse$envelope_1)[i]
    if (!j %in% unique(pse$start_id[pse$envelope_1 == e])) next
    coords$Y[coords$envelope_1 == unique(pse$envelope_1)[i] & coords$start_id == j] <- data$first[data$envelope_1 == unique(coords$envelope_1)[i] & data$start_id == j] + coords$Y[coords$envelope_1 == unique(coords$envelope_1)[i] & coords$start_id == j]
  }
}
```

```{r}
minmax <- c()
for (i in unique(coords$Participant)) {
  for (j in unique(coords$start_id)) {
    for (k in unique(coords$envelope_1)) {
      for (l in unique(coords$repetition)) {
        for (m in unique(coords$type)) {
          if (!m %in% unique(data$type[data$Participant == i & data$start_id == j & data$envelope_1 == k & data$repetition == l])) next
          above = max(data$trial_num[data$Participant == i & data$start_id == j & data$envelope_1 == k & data$repetition == l & data$type == m & data$direction == "Above"])
          below = max(data$trial_num[data$Participant == i & data$start_id == j & data$envelope_1 == k & data$repetition == l & data$type == m & data$direction == "Below"])
          minmax = c(above, below)
          coords$X[coords$Participant == i & coords$start_id == j & coords$envelope_1 == k & coords$repetition == l & coords$type == m] <- ifelse(
            coords$X[coords$Participant == i & coords$start_id == j & coords$envelope_1 == k & coords$repetition == l & coords$type == m] == 0,
            min(minmax), 
            max(minmax))
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

```{r}
envelopes <- data.frame("Participant" = pse$Participant, "start_id" = pse$start_id, "envelope_1" = pse$envelope_1, "type" = pse$type, "repetition" = pse$repetition, "Flat" = 0, "Percussive" = 0)

for (i in 1:length(pse$Participant)) {
  envelopes$Flat[i] <- ifelse(pse$envelope_1[i] == "flat", pse$standard[i], pse$PSEtotal[i])
}
for (i in 1:length(pse$Participant)) {
  envelopes$Percussive[i] <- ifelse(pse$envelope_1[i] == "perc", pse$standard[i], pse$PSEtotal[i])
}

data$ratio <- 0
data$ratio[data$envelope_1 == "flat"] <- data$second[data$envelope_1 == "flat"] / data$first[data$envelope_1 == "flat"]
data$ratio[data$envelope_1 == "perc"] <- data$first[data$envelope_1 == "perc"] / data$second[data$envelope_1 == "perc"]
data$resp2 <- 0
data$resp2[data$envelope_1 == "perc" & data$type == "Heterogenous"] <- ifelse(data$resp[data$envelope_1 == "perc"] == 0, 1, 0)
data$resp2[data$envelope_1 == "flat" & data$type == "Heterogenous"] <- data$resp[data$envelope_1 == "flat"]
data$resp2[data$type == "Homogenous"] <- data$resp[data$type == "Homogenous"]
```

```{r}
hetpse <- pse[pse$type == "Heterogenous",]
hompse <- pse[pse$type == "Homogenous",]

envelopes2 <- rbind(envelopes[envelopes$type == "Heterogenous",], envelopes[envelopes$type == "Heterogenous",])
envelopes2$Participant[101:200] <- "Overall"
pse2 <- rbind(hompse, hompse)
pse2$Participant <- as.character(pse2$Participant)
pse2$Participant[101:200] <- "Overall"
poly <- data.frame(x = c(800, 1700, 1700, 800), y = c(600, 600, 200, 200))
pseall <- rbind(pse, pse)
pseall$Participant <- as.character(pseall$Participant)
pseall$Participant[201:400] <- "Overall"
pseall <- pseall |> 
  group_by(Participant, standard, envelope_1, type) |> 
  summarise(m = max(PSEtotal))
pseall <- pseall |> slice(rep(1:n(), each = 2))
pseall$m[seq(0, (nrow(pseall) - 2), 2) + 1] <- 200
pseall$m[pseall$type == "Homogenous" & pseall$envelope_1 == "perc" & pseall$m == 200] <- 1700
pseall$m[pseall$type == "Homogenous" & pseall$envelope_1 == "perc" & pseall$m != 1700] <- pse2 |> 
  filter(type == "Homogenous" & envelope_1 == "perc") |> 
  group_by(Participant, standard) |> 
  summarise(m = min(PSEtotal)) |> 
  pull(m)
pse2$envelope_1 <- factor(pse2$envelope_1)
envelopes2$envelope_1 <- factor(envelopes2$envelope_1)
pse2$group <- rep(pse2$Participant[1:(nrow(pse2) / 2)], 2)
envelopes2$group <- rep(envelopes2$Participant[1:(nrow(envelopes2) / 2)], 2)
pseall$m[pseall$type == "Homogenous" & pseall$Participant == "Overall" & pseall$m == 1700] <- 200
pseall$m[pseall$type == "Homogenous" & pseall$Participant == "Overall" & pseall$m != 200] <- 1700
pseall$m[pseall$type == "Heterogenous" & pseall$Participant == "Overall" & pseall$m != 200] <- 1700
```
